templates.name: Create Building Layout
templates.description: Create a basic building with grid, levels, walls, rooms, and tags
steps: 1. create_grid — define axis grid for the building footprint
2. create_level — create floor levels at specified elevations
3. create_line_based_element — create exterior walls along grid lines
4. create_room — place rooms inside enclosed wall boundaries
5. tag_all_rooms — tag rooms with name and number

templates.name: Query Model and Export Data
templates.description: Extract model data, analyze statistics, and export room information
steps: 3. analyze_model_statistics — get element counts by category
4. export_room_data — extract room areas, volumes, parameters

templates.description: Create structural beams with grid layout and levels

templates.name: Modify and Recolor Elements
templates.description: Select, modify, and recolor elements by parameter value
steps: 3. color_elements — apply color coding by parameter

templates.name: Advanced C# Execution
templates.description: Use send_code_to_revit for complex API operations beyond dedicated tools
steps: 3. query_revit_registry — check if a verified entry exists
